name: Stability Ball Hamstring Curl
steps: Lie on your back with your heels and lower calves on the ball and your arms on the floor beside you.
Press through your heels to lift your hips into a straight bridge from shoulders to ankles.
Keeping your hips lifted high, bend your knees to roll the ball smoothly in toward your glutes by contracting your hamstrings strongly.
Slowly straighten your legs to roll the ball away, then lower your hips to finish.
tips: Raise your hips slightly higher as the ball rolls in so your pelvis never sags toward the floor.
Press your palms and upper back gently into the floor to stabilize your torso.
